summary: The root HWN describes something that is low, base, vile, or contemptible. It can also mean something is easy or gentle. In the Quran, it often refers to a state of humiliation or insignificance.
lane: 1 هَانَ ذ , inf. n. هَوَانٌ and هُونٌ (Msb, K) and مَهَانَةٌ , (K,) He, or it, was, or became, low, base, vile, abject, mean, paltry, contemptible, despicable, ignominious, inglorious, and weak; syn. ذَلَّ , (Msb, K,) and حَقُرَ , (Msb,) and ضَعُفَ . (TA.) -b2- هَانَ عَلَيْهِ [ It was of light estimation to him ] It (a thing) was [ easy and ] light to him. (TA.) -b3- هَانَ also, He, or it, was, or became, gentle, and easy. (Msb.)

headwords.def: inf. n. هَوَانٌ and هُونٌ (Msb, K) and مَهَانَةٌ, (K,) He, or it, was, or became, low, base, vile, abject, mean, paltry, contemptible, despicable, ignominious, inglorious, and weak; syn. َلَّ, (Msb, K,) and حَقُرَ, (Msb,) and ضَعُفَ. (TA.) هَانَ عَلَيْهِ [ It was of light estimation to him ] It (a thing) was [ easy and ] light to him. (TA.) هَانَ also, He, or it, was, or became, gentle, and easy. (Msb.)

هَوَّنَهُ عَلَيْهِ He (God) made it easy and light to him. (K, * TA.) هَوِّنِى الأَمْرَ وَلاَ تَحْزَنِيى لَهُ [ Make thou the case, or affair, light, or easy; i. e., regard it lightly; and do not grieve for it ]. (TA, art. خفض.)

and بِهِ, and بِهِ, He held him in light, or little, or mean, estimation, or in contempt; despised him; made light of him or it. (S, K, &c.) أَهَانَهُ He lowered, or abased, him; debased him; rendered him abject, vile, mean, paltry, contemptible, despicable, or ignominious.
and Easy: (S, Msb, K:) and the latter of light estimation, paltry, despicable. (K, * TA.)
in the sense of هَيِّنٌ: see أَكْبَرُ. See also an ex. voce بَصِيرَةٌ; and another voce بَعْرٌ.
بَعِيرٌ مُهَانٌ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ [ A camel held in mean estimation by his owner ]. (TA, art. دفع.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
